compare_previous_to_current.meaning: V48 frozen product/toolchain inputs were not changed by this commit, but the new regression proves V48 did not freeze a sufficient Agent safety boundary.

root_cause: SubagentTombstoneStore._persist_snapshot replaces the canonical marker file before syncing the parent directory. During resolve_call, a forced parent-sync failure after successful replace can leave the canonical pathname without the inflight no-replay marker. A fresh process can then load clean state and replay an already-completed local side effect.

Re-run composed tombstone/restart boundary together with V41/V45 protected no-failover and Stage-B orchestration.
